reviews.name: iHerb Customer
reviews.body: These pads are excellent for achieving that plump, "glass skin" look. They are massive, completely saturated in a rich, fragrance-free PDRN and hyaluronic acid essence, and come with handy tweezers. I highly recommend using them as a 5-minute mini mask on your cheeks. It instantly revives dull, dehydrated skin. Just note that while the formula is completely fragrance-free, it does have a slight bitter taste if it accidentally gets on your lips—something to keep in mind if you have a high flavor sensitivity. Also, the finish is quite rich and tacky, so give it a few minutes to sink in before applying makeup to avoid pilling. Perfect for dry or normal skin types!
